content: Esoo na'unnedu togesapa, “Gi nasookwipana ka nananesootuhidu moohena esoo besa'yoo.”

Ka mu nananesootuhidu moohedu sakwa kaaheno besa tumatugudu. Umu sakwa no'yoona nanasu'mu nonodukwa-ga. Umu sakwa gi suda-ma nama'emukwa, besa tutusooyugwedu, gi numu nasootza'mekupana tuwazoo. Umu sakwa ka mu numu tummatzi ka tooe hekwi tooe. Umu sakwa gi puusoo ewow hemma sookwipana, umu gi baagoedu. Umu sakwa gi nidyupupana, gi etzaga sutapana, besa ooosapa numu matugu.

Umu sakwa besa numu tunedyooedu. Umu sakwa oo sopedakwatoo ka tu nodukwa no'oko tu dooamu tunemadabueku, o'no umu tu naa nakabetseakwu. Umu ka gi pummesoo dooamu meeoo tunedyooena, umu tookwa gi ka Te Naa dooamu meeoo tunedyooe-wa'ne'yoo.
Umu sakwa gi pudu tunaka'oedyukudu. Umu ka ooonne'yoona sumuna paba nasooyugwekwu. Soo suda tu tumatuguna umu-matoosoo kodyukwu ka Sutakoo tu yugwe-kwa'nesoo.
Umu sakwa mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu-tamme kaaheno'yoo besa mu nematugu, o'no yise numu gi mu nesootzema-wa'ne'yoo. Ka mu numu sumuna umu nesootze'ma soo suta'yoo suda-kwi mu mesoo mayugwe.

Mu numu nanesootuhidu tummatzikwudu sakwa besa na'eya'ese o'no sakwa umu nanetutzea. Mu tunaka'oedyukudu sakwa oo mooe sopedakwatoo ka besa'yoona. Umu nanetutzeadu sakwa ka Te Naa podo besa tu meakwuna tzapoonne umu sakwa gi esagoepana, gi baagoepana, gi numu tu'ooepana, gi puusoo hemma natoogoo soogwipana tuwazoo. Ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-wi tunaka'oedyukuna ka puusoo nasopedakwadoona ka Te Naa besa podo meana.
Mu pepeawabe ka mu nanesootuhidu tummatziwabe sakwa punno'o besa'yoo. Umu sakwa gi numu nesootzemapana, gi etzaga ha'yoo tooe naneyugwepana, ooosapa kaaheno besa tumatuguna o'no besa'yoo.
Mu nanesootuhidu tutummatziwabe sakwa nanasusumu nonodukwa-ga, mu doodooamu sakwa punno'o besa mu nakabetsea, no'oko tu nobe-witu meeoo tunedyooe tuwazoo.
Umu ka besa mu nanesootuhidu tutummatzina mu numu besa mu sooyugwe. Umuoo gi nasookwina Te Pabe'e Jesus-witu wahakwu.
Nu yabesoo u-baa soopetuga'a pana sumuna nu gi oo mane-wa'ne'yoo. Ooonne'yoona nu u-matoo tubo'o, o'no yise u ka Te Tubetse Naa-matoo nanesootuhibu kaaheno mu numu tunedyooe.

content.text: Te Pabe'e yaa teepu-kooba tamme-wa'nesoo nadooa'adoopu. Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha oo tzapoonne oosoo Te Naa Besa Tooa'a. Oobe pa'atoo tamme-koobatoosoo ka Te Naa-baatoo oosoo kodyuka. No'obatusoo numu ka Te Pabe'e-witu nawahana nakakoo. Yise tooe hano tooe susumudu numu oe tunaka'oedyukute.
